constraints.name: speech_operation_lifecycle_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((execution_state = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'reserved'::text])) AND (cancellation_requested = false) AND (dispatch_claimed_at IS NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code IS NULL)) OR ((execution_state = 'dispatching'::text) AND (dispatch_claimed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code IS NULL)) OR ((execution_state = 'succeeded'::text) AND (dispatch_claimed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code = ANY (ARRAY['transcript'::text, 'no_speech'::text]))) OR ((execution_state = 'failed'::text) AND (dispatch_claimed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code = ANY (ARRAY['invalid_media'::text, 'timeout'::text, 'provider_failure'::text]))) OR ((execution_state = 'uncertain'::text) AND (dispatch_claimed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code = ANY (ARRAY['timeout'::text, 'provider_failure'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND ((safe_outcome_code <> 'cancelled'::text) OR (cancellation_requested = true))) OR ((execution_state = 'cancelled'::text) AND (cancellation_requested = true) AND (dispatch_claimed_at IS NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code IS NOT NULL) AND (safe_outcome_code = 'cancelled'::text))))

constraints.name: speech_operation_tombstone_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((tombstone = false) OR ((execution_state = 'cancelled'::text) AND (source_kind IS NULL) AND (content_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (funding_reservation_id IS NULL))))
